warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the five-dimensional (2x3v) canonical Poisson-bracket kernels on a cylindrical metric, the P1 basis and the energy-moment diagnostic (the toroidal twin, rt_can_pb_bgk_surf_toroidal_sodshock_im_2x3v_p1, is numerically unstable at the pin and was not selected). In `rt_can_pb_bgk_surf_cylindrical_sodshock_im_2x3v_p1.c`, `nl` (line 81) is the inner density of the discontinuity; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong cylindrical metric, a wrong 2x3v surface term or a wrong implicit BGK step changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-11, rtol=1e-11 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 1.0e-3 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 1.7e-3 (worst files `neut-energy-moment.gkyl` and `neut-energy-moment.gkyl`), a headroom of about 603x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
